title: Duncan's 4-Day Upper/Lower 10's V2
author: Duncan S.
desc:
Personal general hypertrophy upper/lower program in preparation for strength blocks. 4 weeks accumulation + 1 week de-load.

Schedule:
Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday.

ex.note: Soft touch on the chest.

ss.note: Swing arm out 30 degrees, touch the shoulders at the bottom.

ex.note: Breath in on the way down, breath out on the way up. Try not to stop at the top of the movement.
Reach out/forward slightly so bar is over the toes.

ss.note: Squeeze two seconds at the top. Let stretch for two seconds at the bottom.

ex.note: Lower to at least below the chin.
Squeeze for two seconds at the top. Let dead hang at the bottom.

ss.note: Use the two-arm rope attachment. Set cable to shoulder height. Lean slightly forward.
Use the two-arm rope attachment.

ex.note: Breath in on the way down, breath out on the way up. Hold tightness at the bottom for 1 second.
Reach out/forward slightly so bar is over the toes.

ss.note: Squeeze two seconds at the top. Let stretch for two seconds at the bottom.
